basis:
Create a production-ready TRANSPARENT sprite atlas for one adult game fighter, redesigned to match the polished arcade boss style of the FIRST reference. The second reference is the fighter's OLD design, for identity/costume/palette only. Replace its simple emoji/doll geometry with sculpted organic adult cartoon anatomy, strong shoulders, chunky dimensional fists, expressive angular brows, detailed fabric folds and hair, glossy saturated colors, thick near-black purple ink outlines, crisp rich cel-shading and creamy highlights, exactly like the first reference. Adult cartoon fighter proportions: head about one third of body height. No baby/chibi proportions. Friendly humorous sports combat, no blood.
EXACT LAYOUT: landscape canvas 1536x1024, precisely THREE EQUAL COLUMNS and TWO EQUAL ROWS, 512x512 per cell. Exactly SIX complete full-body drawings of the SAME character, one in each cell, no other people. Each drawing fits inside a centered 330px-wide by 440px-high rectangle within its cell; feet at y=470 in EACH cell, all poses same head/body scale. Leave at least 35px transparent margins, keep ALL gloves, hair, horns, shoes inside their cell. NO dividing lines, labels, text, floor, ground shadow, scenery, detached props or backgrounds. Actual transparent alpha.
Reading order:
TOP LEFT = READY: both boxing fists raised at chest in guard, knees flexed, determined mischievous grin.
TOP MIDDLE = UPPERCUT: right glove thrust UP diagonally above shoulder toward a boss, left glove by chest, fierce open-mouth shout, dynamic torso twist.
TOP RIGHT = VICTORY: BOTH arms held high above head in V, huge joyful open grin.
BOTTOM LEFT = DAZED: both arms hang down, knees buckle inward, slumped shoulders, X-shaped eyes, three small golden stars orbit above head. Remain full height enough, shoes same baseline.
BOTTOM MIDDLE = PULL: body leaning backward with both fists reaching together to the left side at waist/chest level, elbows bent pulling an INVISIBLE rope, strain expression. No rope drawn.
BOTTOM RIGHT = CLIMB: one glove raised overhead and other near waist, one knee raised and other foot planted at same baseline, determined face, climbing an INVISIBLE wall. No wall drawn.
Keep hairstyle, headgear, skin, costume colors, chest pictogram, shoes and gloves IDENTICAL in all six cells. Readable silhouette at only 54px screen width. Do not copy the boss king's beard or crown onto this athlete unless specified below.
CHARACTER:
basisAbFigur4:
Create a transparent production game sprite sheet for ONE adult sports fighter, with SIX full body poses. Use the FIRST reference ONLY for polished arcade boss art style: thick dark purple ink outlines, dimensional organic cartoon adult anatomy and muscular arms, rich glossy saturated colors, crisp cel shadow shapes and warm creamy highlights, expressive brows, detailed fabric folds and hair. The SECOND reference is the fighter's OLD design for identity, hair, headgear, clothes, colors and chest emblem only. Replace its simple doll geometry. No baby/chibi, head one third of total body height, humorous athletic adult.
EXACT LAYOUT: landscape 1536x1024, THREE equal columns by TWO equal rows, each cell 512x512. ONE complete full-body view of the SAME fighter in each of the SIX cells. Fit each within 360px width and 440px height centered in its cell, feet at cell y470. Preserve scale of body and head between poses. Keep all hair, gloves, horns, shoes inside cell with generous transparent gaps.
TOP LEFT ready: both gloves before chest, knees flexed, grinning determined.
TOP CENTER uppercut: right glove raised diagonally above shoulder, other glove at chest, shouting.
TOP RIGHT victory: BOTH gloves overhead in V, joyful cheer.
BOTTOM LEFT KO: arms hanging, shoulders slumped, knees buckled, X eyes and three golden stars above head.
BOTTOM CENTER pull: lean backward, both gloves together reaching left, bent arms pulling invisible rope, strain face. No rope.
BOTTOM RIGHT climb: one glove overhead, other near waist, one knee raised, other foot planted on same baseline, determined. No wall.
All six share exactly same face, hair, headgear, costume, colors, shoes, gloves, chest emblem. Actual transparent background, no backdrop, ground, cast shadows, lettering or grid lines. No detached accessories. Style reference ONLY: do NOT copy the king's crown or red beard onto the athlete.
